description: Two chapters independently reference the same anchor event (a warehouse fire) but state incompatible elapsed times — '10 years since the fire' in one, '15 years since the fire' in another, with no in-story reason for the discrepancy. Matches the confirmed elapsed-span fork defect shape handled by scan_elapsed_span_consistency in narasi_arithmetic.py (NARASI_AGE_LEDGER flag).
mechanism: narasi_arithmetic.scan_elapsed_span_consistency — deterministic, offline, no model call. Real function invoked directly.
input_text:
The warehouse fire happened ten years ago, and the neighborhood had still not fully recovered. The charred beams remained visible from the overpass, a landmark nobody spoke about.

Fifteen years after the fire, Bimo finally agreed to walk past the site again. His daughter had never seen it, and she asked too many questions.
negative_control_text:
The warehouse fire happened ten years ago, and the neighborhood had still not fully recovered. The charred beams remained visible from the overpass, a landmark nobody spoke about.

Ten years was enough to change a person, but not enough to change the view from the overpass. Bimo still crossed to the other side of the street.
